changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS processed_events ( consumer_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, user_id UUID NOT NULL, meal_id UUID NOT NULL, calories INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (calories >= 0), consumed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (consumer_name, user_id, meal_id) ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_processed_calories_period ON processed_events (user_id, consumed_at);
